constants.description: Returns the name of the .ini file associated with Microsoft Access.

constants.name: acSysCmdAccessDir
constants.description: Returns the name of the directory where Msaccess.exe is located.

constants.name: acSysCmdGetObjectState
constants.description: Returns the state of the specified database object. You must specify argument1 and argument2 when you use this action value.

constants.name: acSysCmdProfile
constants.description: Returns the \/profile setting specified by the user when starting Microsoft Access from the command line.

constants.name: acSysCmdGetWorkgroupFile
constants.description: Returns the path to the workgroup file (System.mdw).

constants.name: acSysCmdCompile
constants.description: Compiles the Visual Basic code modules in the current database. Equivalent to the Debug > Compile menu command.

constants.name: acSysCmdGetMsoBuildNumber
constants.description: Returns the build number of the shared MSO component as a Long. This is the same value returned by Application.Build, and it may differ from the Access application build. Use acSysCmdGetBuildNumber (725) in new code to get the Access build number.

constants.name: acSysCmdGetFullVersion
constants.description: Returns a display string containing version, build, channel, and bitness (for example, "Microsoft Access (Version 2601) Build 16.0.19628.20000 Current Channel 64-bit"). Version 2604 and later.

constants.name: acSysCmdGetVersion
constants.description: Returns the short YYMM marketing version (for example, "2601"). Version 2604 and later.

constants.name: acSysCmdGetFullBuildNumber
constants.description: Returns the full four-part build string (for example, "16.0.19916.30000"). Version 2604 and later.

constants.name: acSysCmdGetChannelName
constants.description: Returns the update channel name (for example, "Current Channel", "Monthly Enterprise Channel", or "LTSC 2024"). Version 2604 and later.

constants.name: acSysCmdGetBitness
constants.description: Returns "32-bit" or "64-bit" as a string matching the bitness of the running binary. Version 2604 and later.

constants.name: acSysCmdGetBuildNumber
constants.description: Returns the major build number (for example, 19916) as a Long. Version 2604 and later.

enumerations.name: AcTextFormat
enumerations.description: Used with the TextFormat property to specify whether or not rich text is displayed in a Text Box.

enumerations.name: AcTextTransferType
enumerations.description: Used with the DoCmd.TransferText method (Access) method to specify the type of transfer you want to make.

enumerations.name: AcTransformXMLScriptOption
enumerations.description: Used with the TransformXML method to specify the action taken if the XSL file contains scripting code.

constants.name: acPromptScript
constants.description: The user is prompted to disable or enable the script.

enumerations.name: AcTrendlineOptions
enumerations.description: Specifies the type of trendline to render for a chart series.

enumerations.name: AcValueAxis
enumerations.description: A list of value axes in a chart.

enumerations.name: AcVerticalAnchor
enumerations.description: Used with the VerticalAnchor property to specify how a control is anchored vertically within its layout.

constants.name: acVerticalAnchorTop
constants.description: The control is anchored at the top of its layout.

constants.name: acVerticalAnchorBottom
constants.description: The control is anchored at the bottom of its layout.

constants.name: acVerticalAnchorBoth
constants.description: The control is stretched vertically across its layout.

enumerations.name: AcView
enumerations.description: Specifies an object's view.

enumerations.name: AcWebBrowserScrollBars
enumerations.description: Used by the ScrollBars property to specify whether scroll bars are displayed.

constants.name: acScrollAuto
constants.description: Scroll bars are displayed if the current page in the control is too large to be displayed in its entirely.

enumerations.name: AcWebBrowserState
enumerations.description: Used by the ReadyState property to determine the state of the web browser control.

constants.name: acLoading
constants.description: The web browser control is loading a new document.

constants.name: acLoaded
constants.description: The web browser control has loaded and initialized the new document, but has not yet received all the document data.

constants.name: acInteractive
constants.description: The web browser control has loaded enough of the document to allow limited user interaction, such as choosing hyperlinks that have been displayed.

constants.name: acComplete
constants.description: The web browser control has finished loading the new document and all its contents.

enumerations.name: AcWebUserDisplay
enumerations.description: Specifies information about the current user of a Web database.

enumerations.name: AcWebUserGroupsDisplay
enumerations.description: Specifies the type of information to return about the group membership of the current user of a Web database.

enumerations.name: AcWindowMode
enumerations.description: Specifies the mode in which a form or report is opened.

constants.name: acWindowNormal
constants.description: (Default) The form or report opens in the mode set by its properties.

constants.name: acHidden
constants.description: The form or report is hidden.

constants.name: acIcon
constants.description: The form or report opens minimized in the Windows taskbar.

constants.name: acDialog
constants.description: The form or report's Modal and PopUp properties are set to Yes.

enumerations.name: AcWordCloudShape
enumerations.description: Specifies the shape for a Word Cloud Modern Chart.

enumerations.name: AcWordCloudWordOrientation
enumerations.description: Specifies the word orientation for a Word Cloud Modern Chart.

enumerations.name: Constants
enumerations.description: Predefined constants
